title: Orthostatic Hypotension — Screening Before You Stand a Patient Up

hook.en: A patient who feels dizzy the moment they stand is not "just weak". Learn the lying-to-standing blood pressure test, what a positive result means and how to get someone upright safely.
hook.ur: Jo patient khare hote hi chakkar mehsoos kare woh “sirf kamzor” nahi hota. Lete se khare hone ka blood pressure test, positive result ka matlab aur kisi ko mehfooz tareeqay se khara karna seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll perform the orthostatic blood pressure test, apply the diagnostic criteria, recognise common causes and manage early mobilisation safely.
goal.ur: End tak aap orthostatic blood pressure test karenge, diagnostic criteria lagayenge, aam wajahein pehchanenge aur early mobilisation mehfooz tareeqay se manage karenge.

text.en: **Orthostatic (postural) hypotension** is a fall in blood pressure on standing: **at least 20 mmHg systolic or 10 mmHg diastolic** within 3 minutes of standing (or dizziness). Gravity pools blood in the legs; healthy people compensate in seconds by tightening vessels and speeding the heart. When that reflex fails (dehydration, medicines, autonomic neuropathy, prolonged bed rest, age), the brain is briefly under-perfused: dizziness, blurred vision, falls and syncope.
text.ur: **Orthostatic (postural) hypotension** khare hone par blood pressure ka girna hai: khare hone ke 3 minute ke andar **kam az kam 20 mmHg systolic ya 10 mmHg diastolic** (ya chakkar). Gravity khoon ko taangon mein jama kar deti hai; healthy log chand second mein vessels ko tight kar ke aur dil ko tez kar ke compensate kar lete hain. Jab yeh reflex fail ho (dehydration, dawaiyan, autonomic neuropathy, lambi bed rest, umar) to dimagh ko thori der ke liye kam khoon milta hai: chakkar, dhundli nazar, girna aur behoshi.

text.en: Standing up is like lifting a water-filled hose from lying on the ground to being held vertically: the water drains toward the bottom. A healthy body squeezes the hose (vasoconstriction) and pumps harder to keep the top supplied. If the squeeze fails, the top of the hose (the brain) runs dry for a few seconds.
text.ur: Khare hona zameen par pari hui paani se bhari hose ko seedha pakar kar uthane jaisa hai: paani neeche ki taraf behta hai. Healthy jism hose ko dabata hai (vasoconstriction) aur zyada zor se pump karta hai taake oopar supply rahe. Dabao fail ho jaye to hose ka oopri sira (dimagh) chand second ke liye khushk ho jata hai.

intro.en: The patient rests for 5 minutes, then blood pressure and pulse are taken. After standing, measure again at 1 and 3 minutes. In the demo the pressure falls to 112/72 (−16/−8) at 1 minute and 104/64 (−24/−16) at 3 minutes: a **positive** result because the systolic fall reaches 20 mmHg.
intro.ur: Patient 5 minute rest karta hai, phir blood pressure aur pulse li jati hai. Khare hone ke baad 1 aur 3 minute par dobara naapein. Demo mein pressure 1 minute par 112/72 (−16/−8) aur 3 minute par 104/64 (−24/−16) par aata hai: systolic girawat 20 mmHg tak pohnchne ki wajah se **positive** result.

question.en: Which result is a positive orthostatic test?
question.ur: Kaun sa result positive orthostatic test hai?

text.en: Systolic falls from 130 to 108 mmHg within 3 minutes of standing
text.ur: Khare hone ke 3 minute ke andar systolic 130 se 108 mmHg par aa jaye

feedback.en: Yes — a fall of 20 mmHg or more systolic (or 10 diastolic) is positive.
feedback.ur: Haan — 20 mmHg ya zyada systolic (ya 10 diastolic) girna positive hai.

text.ur: Systolic 130 se 122 mmHg par aa jaye

feedback.en: An 8 mmHg fall is below the threshold.
feedback.ur: 8 mmHg girawat hadd se kam hai.

feedback.en: A rise in pulse is the normal compensation.
feedback.ur: Pulse ka barhna normal compensation hai.

steps.title: Lie flat for 5 minutes
steps.detail: Resting supine (or seated if lying is not possible) before the first reading, so blood volume redistributes. || 5 minute seedha letein

steps.title: Measure BP and pulse
steps.detail: Note the baseline in the same arm, supported at heart level. || BP aur pulse naapein

steps.title: Stand the patient with support
steps.detail: Stay close, have a chair behind them and ask about symptoms (dizziness, blurred vision, weakness). || Patient ko sahare ke saath khara karein

steps.title: Re-measure at 1 and 3 minutes
steps.detail: Keep the arm supported at heart level; stop and sit the patient down at once if symptoms are severe. || 1 aur 3 minute par dobara naapein

steps.title: Interpret and act
steps.detail: Positive when the systolic falls 20 mmHg or more or the diastolic 10 mmHg or more, or when symptoms occur; record numbers and tell the medical team. || Samjhein aur amal karein

text.en: **Not resting first, or standing too fast and unsupported.** A patient who has just walked in will not have a true baseline, and a patient stood quickly can faint and fall. Also remember that a **pulse that rises less than about 15 beats** with the fall may point to **neurogenic** (autonomic) causes, while a large rise suggests volume depletion. Do not forget to ask about medicines and what the patient drank or ate.
text.ur: **Pehle rest na karna ya bohat tez aur bina sahare khara karna.** Abhi chal kar aaye patient ka asal baseline nahi hoga, aur tez khara kiya gaya patient behosh ho kar gir sakta hai. Yeh bhi yaad rakhein ke girawat ke saath **takriban 15 beats se kam barhne wali pulse** **neurogenic** (autonomic) wajahon ki taraf ishara kar sakti hai, jabke bari izafa volume ki kami batata hai. Dawaiyon aur patient ne kya piya ya khaya ye poochna na bhoolein.

question.en: A patient's pulse barely rises (65 to 68) while systolic pressure falls by 30 mmHg on standing. What does this suggest?
question.ur: Patient ki pulse mushkil se barhti hai (65 se 68) jabke khare hone par systolic pressure 30 mmHg gir jata hai. Yeh kya batata hai?

text.en: A neurogenic cause (autonomic failure), not simple dehydration
text.ur: Neurogenic wajah (autonomic failure), sadaa dehydration nahi

feedback.en: Yes — in volume depletion the heart rate rises to compensate; a flat heart-rate response suggests the reflex arc itself is impaired.
feedback.ur: Haan — volume ki kami mein heart rate compensate karne ke liye barhti hai; flat heart-rate response batati hai ke reflex arc khud kharab hai.

feedback.en: Dehydration usually produces a clear rise in heart rate.
feedback.ur: Dehydration aam taur par heart rate mein wazeh izafa karti hai.

feedback.en: A 30 mmHg fall is clearly abnormal.
feedback.ur: 30 mmHg girawat wazeh taur par ghair-mamooli hai.

text.en: **Make standing safe.** For a patient with a positive test: sit on the edge of the bed for a few minutes first, use staged mobilisation (tilt table, sitting, standing at the bedside), teach ankle pumps and leg crossing or "muscle tensing" before standing, advise slow position changes and small frequent meals, review medicines with the doctor (alpha-blockers, diuretics, antihypertensives, antidepressants) and encourage fluids unless restricted. Compression stockings or abdominal binders may help after medical advice.
text.ur: **Khare hona mehfooz banayein.** Positive test wale patient ke liye: pehle chand minute bistar ke kinare par baithein, staged mobilisation (tilt table, baithna, bistar ke qareeb khara hona) use karein, khare hone se pehle ankle pumps aur legs cross karna ya “muscle tensing” sikhayein, position aahista badalne aur chhote baar baar khane ki salah dein, dawaiyon (alpha-blockers, diuretics, antihypertensives, antidepressants) ka doctor ke saath review karein aur jab tak mana na ho paani ki hausla afzai karein. Medical salah ke baad compression stockings ya abdominal binders madad kar sakte hain.

question.en: Why are older adults and people after bed rest at greater risk of orthostatic hypotension?
question.ur: Buzurg aur bed rest ke baad log orthostatic hypotension ke zyada khatray mein kyun hotay hain?

answer.en: Because the baroreflex that tightens vessels and speeds the heart gets slower with age, blood volume and muscle pump fall with inactivity, and many older adults take several medicines that lower pressure. After even a few days in bed, the reflex deconditions, so early mobilisation is itself protective.
answer.ur: Kyunke vessels ko tight aur dil ko tez karne wala baroreflex umar ke saath sust ho jata hai, inactivity se blood volume aur muscle pump kam hoti hai, aur bohat se buzurg kayi dawaiyan lete hain jo pressure kam karti hain. Sirf chand din bistar par rehne ke baad bhi reflex deconditioned ho jata hai, is liye early mobilisation khud hifazat hai.

question.en: Which instruction helps prevent a faint when standing up?
question.ur: Khare hote waqt behoshi se bachne mein kaun si hidayat madad karti hai?

text.en: Sit at the edge of the bed first, pump the ankles and stand up slowly with support
text.ur: Pehle bistar ke kinare baithein, ankles ko pump karein aur sahare ke saath aahista khare hon

feedback.en: Yes — staged position changes give the reflex time to catch up.
feedback.ur: Haan — position ki marhala-war tabdeeli reflex ko pakarne ka waqt deti hai.

text.en: Stand quickly to get it over with
text.ur: Jaldi se khare hon taake kaam khatam ho

feedback.en: Fast standing makes the drop worse.
feedback.ur: Tez khare hone se girawat zyada hoti hai.

text.ur: Chakkar kam karne ke liye paani se parhez

feedback.ur: Dehydration orthostatic hypotension ko bigaarti hai.

text.en: **Call for help** if standing causes loss of consciousness, chest pain, a very slow or irregular pulse, a fall to systolic below 90 mmHg, or if a new postural drop comes with black stools, vomiting or diarrhoea (bleeding or dehydration). Lay the patient flat and raise the legs. Do not walk a patient who has just fainted.
text.ur: **Madad bulayein** agar khare hone se behoshi, seene ka dard, bohat aahista ya ghair-hamwar pulse, systolic ka 90 mmHg se neeche girna ho, ya naya postural girawat kaale pakhane, ulti ya dast (khoon behna ya dehydration) ke saath ho. Patient ko seedha lita kar taangein uthayein. Abhi behosh hue patient ko chalayein nahi.

summary.en: A fall of at least 20 mmHg systolic or 10 mmHg diastolic within 3 minutes of standing (or symptoms) is orthostatic hypotension.
summary.ur: Khare hone ke 3 minute ke andar kam az kam 20 mmHg systolic ya 10 mmHg diastolic (ya symptoms) ka girna orthostatic hypotension hai.

summary.en: Rest first, stand with support, measure at 1 and 3 minutes and read the pulse response to guess the cause.
summary.ur: Pehle rest, sahare ke saath khara karein, 1 aur 3 minute par naapein aur wajah ka andaza lagane ke liye pulse response parhein.

summary.en: Mobilise in stages, teach counter-manoeuvres, review medicines and call for help if the patient faints or the pressure falls below 90 systolic.
summary.ur: Marhala-war mobilise karein, counter-manoeuvres sikhayein, dawaiyon ka review karein aur patient behosh ho ya systolic 90 se neeche aaye to madad bulayein.

back.en: A fall of at least 20 mmHg systolic or 10 mmHg diastolic within 3 minutes of standing (or symptoms).
back.ur: Khare hone ke 3 minute ke andar kam az kam 20 mmHg systolic ya 10 mmHg diastolic ki girawat (ya symptoms).

front.en: When do you measure after standing?
front.ur: Khare hone ke baad kab naapte hain?

back.en: At 1 and 3 minutes (after 5 minutes of rest lying or seated).
back.ur: 1 aur 3 minute par (5 minute lete ya baithe rest ke baad).

front.en: A flat heart-rate response to a big pressure fall suggests?
front.ur: Bari pressure girawat par flat heart-rate response kya batata hai?

back.en: A neurogenic (autonomic) cause rather than volume depletion.
back.ur: Volume ki kami ke bajaye neurogenic (autonomic) wajah.

front.ur: Mehfooz khare hone ki do hikmat-e-amliyan?

back.en: Staged position changes (sit first) and ankle pumps or muscle tensing before standing.
back.ur: Marhala-war position tabdeeli (pehle baithna) aur khare hone se pehle ankle pumps ya muscle tensing.
